content:
maria: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting Console graphs not loading. Ticket INC-2026 (acme.io) shows blank charts and a spinner. I can repro in our staging console as well. Seeing 500s/timeouts from analytics API when loading the graph panel.

aj: Which endpoint is failing? Any correlation IDs?

maria: Hitting: GET /api/analytics/metrics?org=acme&range=1h returns 500. Example curl (redacted):

```
curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' 'https://console.redwood.ai/api/analytics/metrics?org=acme&range=1h'
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: application/json
X-Correlation-ID: 7f3a1c2b-0e4d
{"error":"internal error","message":"timeout fetching timeseries"}
```

Also seeing periodic timeouts (~10s) in Chrome devtools when the console queries the analytics API.

tonY: (oncall) I can take it. Noticed a spike in 5xxs from analytics-proxy around 12:40 UTC. My quick glance at metrics shows increased backend latency to clickhouse/warehouse and a bunch of 504s from our query service.

sahil: We pushed analytics-proxy v2.4.1 at 12:37 UTC that changed query fanout logic. Suspect the new parallel queries are overloading a downstream pool. Rolling back might help.

ben: Can you paste logs? I want to see the stack/trace. If it's query overload then rollback is safest short term.

maria: Pasting a trimmed error from support logs: 

```
2025-11-18T12:41:03Z ERROR analytics-proxy request_id=7f3a1c2b path=/api/analytics/metrics status=500 duration=10234ms err="warehouse query timeout: deadline exceeded" backend_calls=6
```

aj: That duration is huge. Are we seeing connection saturation to the warehouse? Check connection pool metrics and queue length. Also confirm whether caching layer returned stale empty payloads.

ben: I'm looking at infra dashboard — pool queue length jumped at 12:37 and stayed high for ~20m. Clickhouse CPU spiked, and a few nodes hit GC pauses.

maria: Customer impact: INC-2026 (acme) - graphs blank, their eval dashboards impacted. They're asking if this is a billing-related cut or service degradation.

lisa: We should mark as P1 and create an incident on status.redwood.ai. Start with a short customer note: "We're investigating an issue affecting Console graphs; some dashboards may show errors or be slow." Offer to credit for downtime once we have root cause.

tony: I'm going to roll analytics-proxy back to v2.4.0 now. I'll coordinate the deploy.

deploy-bot: rollback request received. Starting rollout: analytics-proxy:v2.4.0 -> pods=6 -> strategy=rolling.

deploy-bot: rollback complete at 13:05 UTC. healthchecks OK.

ben: After rollback 5xx rate dropped to baseline, warehouse CPU and pool queue length decreased. Samples show graph panels now returning 200 and data.

maria: Verified with acme — they can load charts again. Posting repro steps for support docs and runbook: 

1) Repro (support): Open Console -> Org dropdown -> select ACME -> navigate to "Metrics" dashboard -> observe blank charts.
2) Curl repro: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://console.redwood.ai/api/analytics/metrics?org=acme&range=1h"` should return JSON timeseries. If 500/timeout, note X-Correlation-ID header and escalate to eng-sre channel.
3) Short-term mitigation: rollback analytics-proxy to v2.4.0 OR use the raw CSV endpoint `/api/analytics/raw?org=<org>&range=<range>` to export data.

aj: Additions for runbook: capture warehouse query ids from analytics-proxy logs, check connection pool metrics (conn_in_use, conn_wait_count), and confirm caching layer returns.

maria: I'm updating INC-2026: root cause suspected regression in v2.4.1 query fanout; rolled back to v2.4.0 and restored service. We'll follow up with postmortem.

lisa: Support communications: send a short email to affected customers; offer a 10% credit for the incident window (12:37–13:05 UTC) per SLO. I'll draft message.

ben: For postmortem: look at why our pre-release perf tests didn't detect clickhouse GC interactions; consider adding a synthetic load test for query fanout patterns.

maria: Thanks team. Closing loop: status page updated, customer notified, support ticket updated. Will ping when PMT has the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
